summary: Iteration 17 - Partner space (hotels/concierges/agencies) end-to-end review. BACKEND 11/11 pytest tests PASS (test_iteration17_partner.py, serial mode -n 0): register hotel partner → partner_type=hotel, partner_discount=0.1, tracking_base ends /track; register regular company → partner_discount=0; POST /api/company/bookings (Ritz→CDG, premium, luggage 3) → 201 with price=85.5 (95 fixed −10%), partner_discount_amount=9.5, partner_booking=true, passenger_label='Mr Smith · ch. 412', payment_status='invoiced', booking_ref + share_token; invalid guest_phone '12' → 422; missing guest_name → 422; passenger role token → 403; GET /api/company/bookings?status=active lists it; /company/overview.active_rides ≥1; /company/rides includes it; driver online → GET /api/rides/available includes booking with passenger_label; POST /rides/{id}/accept → 200; backend log contains 'SMS (non envoyé, Twilio non configuré) -> +33611223344' with a '/track/<token>' URL; hotel POST /rides/{id}/cancel → 200. FRONTEND (390×844, hotel.ritz@test.com): login OK → Clients tab renders partner-bookings screen, header shows 'Hôtel Ritz Paris · tarif partenaire −10 %'. partner-new opens partner-booking sheet with guest-name/guest-phone/guest-room fields. partner-pickup 'Ritz' + partner-dropoff 'Orly' both return partner-place-* results (~2s), airport detected → guest-flight appears (filled 'AF123'). All 5 partner-vehicle-* chips render with discounted prices; van selected → partner-submit closes sheet → new card 'Mrs Test · ch. 7' appears in 'En cours' with Pending badge, price (5346.40 €) and (−594.04 €) saving line. booking-share-* on web copies URL via navigator.clipboard.writeText (returns silently). booking-cancel-* fires window.confirm dialog (accepted) → card disappears from 'En cours' → visible under 'Toutes' filter with Cancelled badge. REGISTER: role-company reveals partner-type-{company,hotel,concierge,agency} chips; selecting hotel changes label to 'Nom de l'hôtel'. REGRESSION entreprise@test.com: Dashboard 'Acme Conseil', invite code, budget 60 € / 1 employé, Historique and monthly report tabs all intact; Clients tab is also present (partner space is enabled for every company by default, partner_discount=0). No console errors. Existing DB partner bookings from earlier pytest runs were manually cancelled via UI (Toutes shows several Cancelled Mr Smith cards).

ui_bugs.issue: On web the share flow calls navigator.clipboard.writeText(url) then Alert.alert('Lien copié', url). React Native Web's Alert.alert is not implemented as a browser dialog (no window.alert is fired), so the user copies the tracking link silently with no visual confirmation. Recommend replacing Alert.alert with window.alert(url) / a toast when Platform.OS==='web', or copying via a small in-app snackbar. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(company)/bookings.tsx:36

issues: Nominatim results are not biased to the current city: typing 'Ritz' first returns 22a Kyrkoesplanaden, Vaasa (Finland) instead of Hôtel Ritz Paris; typing 'Orly' returns '94310 Val-de-Marne, France' instead of 'Aéroport Paris-Orly'. Address search still functions and the spec accepts 'first result' but end users will pick wrong POIs. Consider passing a viewbox=Paris or bounded=1 to Nominatim, or seeding a curated place list (Ritz, CDG, Orly, gares, etc.). Reference: /app/frontend/src/hooks/useAddressSearch.ts.

action_items: Optional: replace Alert.alert with window.alert() (or a toast) in the web branch of PartnerBookings.share so hotels get a visible confirmation that the tracking link was copied to the clipboard.
Optional: bias useAddressSearch to the partner's city (viewbox / bounded=1 or a curated POI list) so common queries like 'Ritz' or 'Orly' surface the Paris venues first.

Optional: pytest xdist parallel runs shared module state across workers (booking_id set in one worker was None in another). Kept -n 0 for this suite; consider moving TestPartnerBooking.booking_id onto a module-scope fixture so the file is parallel-safe with other suites.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/company.py:157-186 partner booking creation is correct: reuses build_ride, applies partner_discount server-side, forces payment_status='invoiced', copies phone/guest fields onto the ride doc, and fires a tracking SMS via send_sms. Clean.

SheetModal-based PartnerBookingForm.tsx keeps a single source of pricing: it multiplies estimate.price by (1 - discount) client-side for the vehicle chips AND relies on the server for the authoritative discount amount. Values match (85.50/9.50 in tests).
bookings.tsx uses window.confirm on web for cancel (works well with page.on('dialog')) but Alert.alert for share (does not surface on RN Web). Inconsistent — pick one strategy per platform.
core.tracking_url returns FRONTEND_URL/track/<share_token> and /company/partner returns tracking_base=FRONTEND_URL/track — used by the share() call in bookings.tsx. Verified reachable in SMS log.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested partner flows (create → list → share → cancel → filter, register partner chips, entreprise regression)

Partner form testIDs: partner-new, guest-name/guest-phone/guest-room, partner-pickup/partner-dropoff, partner-address-input, partner-place-<osm_id>, guest-flight (only when service='airport'), guest-pax-*/guest-bags-*, partner-vehicle-<type>, partner-submit.
